usedFor: Moneybird holds your quotes and invoices, and Calendly gets a meeting when “Create One-Time Meeting” follows “New Quote”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in Moneybird, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A sent quote creates a one-time Calendly meeting, so the client can walk through it with you.

watchOut: “New Quote” also fires for drafts you create, so check each quote is ready before the meeting goes out.
